newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela must tighten fiscal discipline - cenbank.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela must tighten fiscal discipline - cenbank.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank will continue to pursue a strong bolivar policy to bear down on inflation, but maintaining low prices will require stronger fiscal discipline, the Central Bank said.

"The results of the first quarter, although in line with the objectives of the economic program adopted last year, require stronger fiscal discipline ... so that the aim of economic stability is not compromised," the Bank said in statement on its first quarter board meeting, held Friday.

Inflation over the first four months of the year reached 9.1 percent, compared to 34.5 percent in the same period last year, but analysts say swelling government spending on the back of a seventy percent-plus public sector pay rise threaten the 30 percent year-end target.
